rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Century Two
rows.Origin:
Bred by David L. Armstrong (United States, 1971).
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in 1975 as 'Century Two'.
rows.Bloom: Pink. Moderate, damask fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Leathery foliage.

Height: up to 4' (up to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Vigorous.
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 3,340 on 22 May 1973 VIEW USPTO PATENT
